justification: GST-3562 letter A (Garry 'Do it' 2026-11-23 to the /ship simplification cut list; Captain GStack Minder's CREW rule 15 ruling, approval a-6ec01c09edf8: "Only B removes a reader that can block a merge. A replaces narrow re-checks with full rounds, K and L remove audits that never block, and F only reorders; none can lose a catch the panel makes."). Deterministic no-loss replay, no paid run: main's transition table frozen at 0408128 (test/fixtures/review-depth-main/next-step-0408128.ts) against this branch's nextStep over 3,932,160 History cases (passes 0-3; last none, full or fix-check; every mix of the four fix flags; range runtime lines unset, null, 0, 5 and 500; pass-1 and step depth unset, light, standard and full; gate, Step 11 run and lean on and off; 0 or 1 fix-checks; 0-3 prior full rounds; with and without a recorded grant and a round grant). 2,757,344 are identical. Every other case is one of five kinds that add review or move a decision to the lane's Captain, never drop a read of changed code: (a) a planned fix-check becomes a full pass on the same range, 133,120; (b) the same stop, voices or done step with reworded reason text, 897,760; (c) a fix-check after a read-only full review, or one a grant bought at the PR's round cap, becomes a stop for the Captain (on gate class after Step 11's voices), 74,880; (d) a below-floor fix main shipped unread (including a light lean fix that changed runtime lines) becomes a full pass, a read-only full review, or a stop, 46,976; (e) a fixed blocker or gate-class edit at the cap, granted or not, gets one read-only full review of the whole PR diff instead of a stop or a fix-check, 22,080. The lean round 2 that replaces a fix-check keeps the fix-check's second-model reader when published numbers changed. Dispatch equality: every kind (a) case must keep main's readers, meaning a full-effort reader that excludes nothing main's fix-check read plus each of main's other readers. The table marks each step that stands where main planned a fix-check, and the read-only final review, with a structured keepReader flag that prCapped's spreads carry; a dispatch with keepReader and no full-effort reader adds the Red Team reader at full effort on the fix range, and a lean keepReader step keeps main's targeted reader, and the bot-review (review.platform) skip applies only to a run's first review. test/helpers/gst3562-replay.ts asserts it on every grid, and test/review-depth-lean.test.ts runs it over 5 diff shapes x review.panel all, risk and off x review.platform off and on with a bot review at HEAD x published numbers or none x a targeted class, an already-read one or none x 0-2 prior full rounds x round grant or none x every in-run history (61,704 changed cases, all of the five kinds). The read-only final review also carries a structured readOnly flag: the dispatcher stages it on the PR's merge base whatever --diff-base the driver passes and prints READ_ONLY, and Step 3's edit guard in ship/sections/review-army.md applies no fix on a pass that printed it; that guard change adds an edit stop and removes no reader or brief byte (test/review-pass.test.ts). This replaces #4737's first attempt, which keyed the rule on reason text and missed three corners (findings/gstack-2026-11-23-full-rounds-first-attempt.md).
